decisions: TB3 offset (`vos_v`) is the input difference at which d2a - d2b crosses zero with the stage-2 cross-coupled loads scaled to m = 0.001, NOT the VDD/2 crossing of the output. Measured (sim/tb3_off/xcheck_trip_mc.json + xcheck_compare.py, 18 paired runs, same seeds, tt): d2-based minus the hysteresis-ON trip-window centre = +0.06 mV mean, 0.81 mV sd; the output-crossing definition is biased by +5.5 mV (sd 3.1) because the weak diode-loaded stage 2 lets the stage-3/inverter threshold leak into the input-referred number. The output-based value stays in the results as `vos_out_v` (report only).

TB3 trip points come from ONE continuous DC sweep per run (supply ramped inside the same sweep because plain `op` does not converge; VID triangle -150 -> +150 -> -150 mV, or the mirror), 0.1 mV steps inside +-40 mV; grid `sweep` = 0/1 selects up-first / down-first. Supply sensitivity (dvh_dvdd, dvtrip_dvdd) comes from the same sweep repeated at VDD 3.0 and 3.6 V.

TB4 stimulus is applied directly at the RX pins (circuit measurement; the input network is used in TB5 and TB12). One transient holds two phases: tr = 0.4 ns edges (tpd_s = max(tPLH, tPHL), skew_s, edge_10_90_s) and the NAMED edge time (1 ns at VID 350 mV, 2 ns at VID 100 mV) for dcd_ui = |tPLH - tPHL| / UI. At VID 100 mV a +10 mV input-offset source is included in both phases. tPD is referenced to the 50 % point of the input edge at the pins.
TB4b (gate TB4b, delta tPD over VID 0.2 / 0.45 V) reuses the TB4 deck and hooks (spec sim/tb4b_pd_vid).

TB5 / TB12: stimulus through netlist/input_network.spice (lvds_input_network; the lane already contains its own secondary ESD, so the *_esd variant would double it): driver emf per side VIC +- VID, 50 ohm source, 100 ohm termination, package pi-model, asig_5p0 pad. Edge times: 1 ns (VID 350 mV) / 2 ns (VID 100 mV) at 100 Mb/s, half of that at 200 Mb/s. 8 lead-in bits + one PRBS7 period (127 bits) compared. BER = bits whose output level at (nominal edge midpoint + median delay + UI/2) differs from the sent bit; toggle_diff = output crossings after data start minus input toggles. The hook was self-tested on synthetic waveforms (sim/tb5_eye/selftest_hooks.py: clean 0 errors, inverted/glitch/jitter cases detected).

TB12 uses VIC 1.2 V and VID follows the rate (0.1 V at 100 Mb/s, 0.35 V at 200 Mb/s), the two conditions for which the spec gives eye limits; pkg index 0..3 = (L, C) = (1 nH, 0.5 pF), (1, 1.5), (5, 0.5), (5, 1.5).

INTERPRETATION of the stimulus, not a limit change: both pins are kept inside the TIA/EIA-644 input range 0..2.4 V, i.e. the effective common mode is min(max(VIC, VID/2), 2.4 - VID/2). For VID = 100 mV this is the whole spec range 0.05..2.35 V (unchanged); for VID = 350 mV the grid values VIC 0.05 / 2.35 V become 0.175 / 2.225 V (reported as vic_eff_v in TB5). Reason (measured): at VIC 0.05 V, VID 350 mV the N pin sits at -0.125 V and ngspice stopped at ss/125C with `Timestep too small` at 70 % of the supply ramp (gear, gmin/reltol and slower ramp did not help); VIC 0.1 V converged. The spec's VIC test points apply to |VID| >= 100 mV per TIA 4.2.4, which does not require pins below 0 V.
Transient stimuli always ramp from 0 together with the supply (a static +-VID/2 at VDD = 0 made ngspice hang at ss/125C: 7 timeouts of 300 s in the first TB4 run).

decisions: ngspice stall: with EN = 1 and a settled supply (TB8 cases 1, 3, 4; TB7 at ff/-40C/3.6 V, VIC 2.35 V) the transient hangs (steps of ps, > 10 min) because a decaying branch quantity of the cap_nmos model reaches the denormal range; `.option reltol=0.01` removes it (abstol, vntol, chgtol, method = gear, rshunt did not). The metrics there are rail levels and 10/90 % excursions, insensitive to 1 % tolerance. It is non-deterministic in the sense that ANY change of the deck text (here: three extra wrdata vectors and dummy resistors in a first TB8 attempt) can move the stall to another run: keep deck edits minimal and re-run the whole bench after each.

TB6 measures two macro copies behind the same input network (disturbed: rails behind 1 ohm + 2 nH per rail, an assumption; reference: ideal quiet rails, static common mode); the supply disturbances are 100 mVpp 25 MHz ripple on the board supply and a 25 MHz train of 20 mA / 1 ns current spikes on the local rails. Measured: ripple <= 0.011 UI, spikes <= 0.011 UI, quiet harness 0.0002 UI, no false toggles anywhere.

TB7: all three lanes see the same idle input (open = 1 Mohm to the common mode behind the 50/100 ohm network, terminated, shorted) at 7 VIC; terminated runs also drift the source +-100 mV at 0.5 mV/ns. v0 held state (reported): LOW in all 105 nominal runs; under mismatch (smoke tier: N = 30 x worst5 x 3 VIC = 450 runs) 64 runs hold 0 lanes HIGH, 176 one, 142 two, 68 three, never an intermediate level.

The 125C / 3.6 V supplement (tb9_input_hot, not gated) is run by flow/run_all.py.

TB10: the three macro lanes carry CLK (1010), D0 and D1 (PRBS7, shifted); crosstalk = per-edge difference of lane k in the 3-lane copy against a copy where only lane k is active (shared bias and a shared 1 ohm + 2 nH supply). TB1 model_warnings no longer counts 'Dynamic gmin stepping failed' / 'source stepping failed' lines of runs that finished with status ok (harness 1.2 already treats a recovered stepping failure as no non-convergence); 23 sf/-40C runs were flagged by it after the sizing iteration.

ngspice stalls and non-convergence are chaotic (the same deck converges with a slightly different option): TB3_off 4 of 15000 runs (op non-convergence), TB7 3 of 945, TB8 19 of 270 ended timeout. Harness 1.3 adds a spec key retry (variants of solver options, circuit and stimulus untouched; the record keeps retry and first_status; gates.json and REPORT.md list retried runs). Variants: TB3_off itl/gmin 1e-10 then gmin 1e-9 (both fixed the 4 runs in 4-6 s); TB7 / TB8 time step 49 ps, then reltol 0.05, then both (the last two fixed the 3 TB8 stalls tried). Timeouts lowered to 240-300 s (normal runs take <= 30 s).

Monte Carlo seeds (A3): seed_mode runkey in tb3_off, tb3_hmc and tb7_idle_mc: seeds are derived from a hash of (campaign seed, corner, grid point, index), distinct inside a group, seeds 1 and 2 skipped (harness mc.runkey_seeds, unit-tested). Before, every (corner, VIC) group reused the same seed list.
Disk: the 15000 TB3_off run directories are deleted after the run (results.json keeps every metric); no .raw files are kept.
